dedupe_keys.name: rooftop height estimation from orthophotos using ml vienna use case

description: Mohamed-Bachir Belaid and Babak Ebrahimi publish approximately 26,000 Vienna rooftop images with reference and predicted roof-height quantities. The FAIRiCUBE collection includes masked images, CSV tables and a trained XGBoost regressor in PKL format, freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Reference values use the difference between maximum and minimum elevations within LOD2.1 rooftop polygons. This measures roof relief, not automatically giving total building height above ground. The provider names a VGG18 feature extractor and XGBoost pipeline; that architecture label and software dependencies require checking before reuse. These materials can help derive geometry inputs or test image-based estimation for building-stock simulations. Prediction transferability and execution compatibility remain uncertain. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the collection. Images, model and reported accuracy were not independently tested.
